pages.label: The Inn Hotel
pages.title: The Inn Hotel - The Cliffs
pages.text:
The Inn Hotel - The Cliffs Skip to content
The Inn
The Inn is perched 200 feet above the pristine waters of Possum Kingdom Lake. All rooms have been renovated to spacious King Suites.
SCHEDULE
your
VISIT
Newly Remodeled
The Inn just got a facelift to the exterior and interior and is a great representation of what makes our development so awe inspiring.
Open Reception
An open lounge area for you to enjoy The Cliffs atmosphere, get some work done, or get to know another guest.
Premium Rooms
Fully stocked rooms with all the modern amenities you could ask for. Come back and relax or plan for the days adventure in comfort
Kitchinette
A mini-fridge to grab a drink and a wonderful bar area to enjoy a snack.
Hours & Contact
Check-in time: 3:00 PM
Check-out time: 11:00 AM
Other Amenities
Everything The Cliffs Has To Offer
.
18-Hole Course
The course is a direct reflection of the designers, renowned golf course architects Bruce Devlin and Robert Von Hagge.
The Beach
The Beach is located at the tip of the Marina and also features picnic areas and a bath house. Beautiful views of the lake and passing ships.
The Chaparral Grille
Southwest-inspired cuisine awaits you at The Chaparral Grille. Enjoy delectable fresh seafood, succulent aged beef and a glass of your favorite wine, served up against views of Possum Kingdom Lake.
Fitness Center
The Fitness Center offers secure, 24-hour access to members and hotel guests, and features a variety of cardiovascular and weight machines.
Conference Center
The Cliffs boasts an 1,800 square foot Conference Center with a lakeview backdrop. A professional staff oversees every detail, allowing guests to focus on the business, or pleasure, at hand.
Swimming
Splash and play or soak in the rays at one of The Cliff’s swimming pools or at our beach
